worksheet.title: Customer Profile Worksheet
worksheet.description: Define the specific person you are selling to. The more precise this is, the easier everything else becomes.

fields.label: Niche customer description
fields.helpText: Who is this person specifically? Include their situation, what they are trying to do, what words they use, and why generic products have not satisfied them.

fields.label: Core problem you solve
fields.helpText: In your customer's own words: what frustration or unmet need does your product address?

fields.label: Where they gather online
fields.helpText: List 3–5 specific communities, subreddits, groups, or channels where your customer spends time.

fields.label: What they value most
fields.helpText: What is the primary driver behind your customer's buying decision?

fields.label: What would make them trust a new seller
fields.helpText: Given they have never heard of you, what signals would make this specific customer feel confident enough to buy?
